verdict.rationale: Omnara is a platform for building and running agents. The evidence shows building blocks only: users can configure agents and connect MCP servers or tools to reach their data, and self-hosted deployments can query agent history in Postgres for their own analytics. Nothing documents a built-in feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product, so the axis applies but has no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
